## Problem and resulting behavior

Describe the trigger and what this change makes the user see or do.

## Validation

List checks actually run, platform/browser, failures and skipped coverage.
Use disposable fixtures. Do not attach real messages, seeds, pairing links,
private addresses, node configuration or backups.

## Compatibility and recovery

Does this change protocol bytes, authorization, storage or release/deployment?
If so, explain compatibility and recovery before requesting review.

Preserve third-party attribution. Report vulnerabilities through SECURITY.md,
not through a public exploit description.
